name: fast
description: Prioritizes inference speed over output fidelity

parameters.name: kv_cache_type
parameters.description: Quantization type applied to both the Key and Value attention caches. Lower bit precision reduces VRAM and memory bandwidth usage at a cost to precision. Ollama applies a single quantization to K and V together — it cannot be set independently.
parameters.note: Set via the OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE environment variable, global to the whole Ollama process — applying a change restarts the Ollama service and affects every model, not just the active one.

parameters.name: n_ctx
parameters.description: Context window size in tokens, defining the maximum prompt and history length the model can process simultaneously.

parameters.name: n_gpu_layers
parameters.description: Number of model layers to offload to the GPU for hardware acceleration. Set to -1 to offload all layers.
parameters.note: maxValue calculated at runtime based on the layers of the loaded model

parameters.name: n_batch
parameters.description: Batch size for prompt processing (prefill). Higher values process input prompts faster but consume more memory during ingestion.

parameters.name: n_threads
parameters.description: Number of CPU threads to allocate for computation during inference.
parameters.note: default = physical cores detected at runtime

parameters.name: mmap
parameters.description: Enables memory-mapping to load the model file directly from disk, reducing startup time and allowing the OS to page weights dynamically.

parameters.name: mlock
parameters.description: Locks model weights in physical RAM to prevent the operating system from paging memory to swap disk, ensuring stable latency.
parameters.note: true only if sufficient free RAM is available, validated at runtime

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Controls randomness in token selection. Lower values make output more deterministic and focused; higher values produce more diverse and creative responses.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Limits token selection to the K highest-probability tokens at each step, filtering out unlikely choices.

parameters.name: top_p
parameters.description: Nucleus sampling probability threshold, restricting generation to candidate tokens whose cumulative probability reaches P.

parameters.name: repeat_penalty
parameters.description: Applies a penalty to recently generated tokens to discourage the model from repeating words, phrases, or looping.

parameters.name: limit_output
parameters.description: Dynamically limits maximum generation tokens based on available context and task type.
parameters.note: if true, num_predict is calculated at runtime based on available n_ctx and task type; if false, num_predict = -1 (unlimited, stopped by EOS)
